newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts transportation bond bill items.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts transportation bond bill items.

text.p: The following is a breakdown of the items that the $3 billion Massachusetts transporation bond issue, which passed one legislative committee on Wednesday, is slated to fund.
* $1,040,300,000 for Central Artery costs reimbursable by the federal government.
* $1,158,750,000 for Central Artery costs to be raised through Grant Anticipation Notes (GANs) and paid off with future federal transportation grants.
* $100,000,000 for interest costs on the GANs.
* $550,000,000 for the statewide, state-funded road and bridge program.
* $504,700,000 for the part of the statewide road and bridge program that is federally reimbursable.
* $200,000,000 for a state-funded bridge repair program
* $150,000,000 for the "Chapter 90" program giving cities and towns direct aid for their transportation projects.
* $100,000,000 for the portion of the Central Artery project for which the federal government will not pay.
* $17,000,000 for the Public Economic Development Program.
* $13,200,000 for safety improvements to I-91 in Springfield.
